Metadata.title: Worvia
Metadata.description: Organize, present, and deliver branding projects through professional client projects.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or is no longer available.

Landing.description: Worvia turns your brand systems into polished client projects where you can present the work, organize assets, and deliver every file in one place.

details.title: A better handoff is part of the design.
details.description: Worvia gives brand designers one considered space to present the thinking, organize the system, and deliver every final asset without breaking the experience.

benefits.title: Tell the story behind the system
benefits.description: Guide clients through the strategy, visual language, and decisions that make the identity work.

benefits.title: Give every asset a clear home
benefits.description: Structure logos, guidelines, colors, typography, and exports in a project clients can understand.

benefits.title: Make the final moment feel designed
benefits.description: Turn delivery into a polished extension of the brand instead of one last folder download.

pricing.title: Put a price on your project.
pricing.description: Designers can set a price for project access and turn a finished presentation into a paid experience for their clients.

plans.title: Choose the scope for each project.
plans.description: Start free and choose the capacity each project needs.

free.name: Free
free.pricing: You can still set a price for access to this project.
free.description: For presenting smaller projects and getting started without friction.
features: 1 section each for files, typography, colors, and galleries

starter.name: Starter
starter.pricing: You can set the price clients pay to access this project.
starter.description: For small client deliveries that need more room.
features: Up to 20 files, colors, or images per section

pro.name: Pro
pro.pricing: You can set the price clients pay to access this project.
features: Up to 30 gallery images and 40 files or colors

premium.name: Premium
premium.pricing: You can set the price clients pay to access this project.
premium.description: For fuller handoffs and projects with a distinct identity.
features: Up to 2 files and typography sections

details.ctaTitle: Your work deserves more than a download link.
details.ctaDescription: Create a project and make the handoff as intentional as the identity.
